sourceSubject: Merged PR 19655: fix: #37855 improve user center sorting and enhance form handling in GratefulParents components

requirements.behavior: Sort user centers with Center User last and alphabetical center names
requirements.rationale: ACP AuthService already applies the same centerRole-disabled-last then localeCompare sort after building userCenters.
sourceEvidence: d1be9b08 apps/eval-portal/.../auth.service.ts userCenters.sort (center user last + localeCompare)
requirements.impact: Center switcher lists admin/owner centers first, alphabetically, with Center User entries last.

requirements.behavior: Land center-admin redirect on first non-center_user center by name
requirements.rationale: ACP canActivateGenericAdmin already filters out center_user and sorts by centerName before picking firstCenter.
requirements.impact: Users without a center in the URL land on a deterministic admin center instead of whoami/DB order.

requirements.behavior: Grateful Parents edit mode reseeds form and treats Jodit content dirty as unsaved
requirements.rationale: Center-admin ACT/SAT/LC Grateful Parents forms already patch on enableEditMode and gate save dialog on form.dirty || isContentDirty; global-admin copies were unchanged in source too.
sourceEvidence: d1be9b08 grateful-parents-*-form enableEditMode patchValue; onShowSaveDialog isContentDirty
requirements.impact: Entering edit restores editor content; Cancel/Save respects rich-text edits that never mark the FormGroup dirty.

requirements.behavior: Ignore Jodit initial echo and emit value changes inside NgZone
requirements.rationale: Shared ACP jodit editor already normalizes HTML on first change and runs valueChange via NgZone.
requirements.impact: Rich-text forms no longer start dirty from editor bootstrap; change detection still runs for edits.
